head: WORKTREE
summary: ADR 0009 covers all required options, decision, SQL guard, CHECK, invariant test and consequences. ADR 0004 note, README index, spec AC2.5/assumption updated. The AC1.2 and roadmap edits are justified: the old wording would contradict the counters or the decision.

acceptance_criteria.evidence: docs/adr/0009-materialised-balance.md Context and Options sections list 3 balance options and 4 concurrency options with pros/cons, plus Decision and Consequences.
ADR 0009 Decision: bigint non-negative counters, atomic UPDATE with WHERE guard, CHECK, counters = sum postings test and UC6 reconciliation, @Version for attributes only.
docs/adr/0004 dated superseded-in-part note, original text kept; docs/adr/README.md index row 0009 and deferred item removed.
docs/spec.md assumption reworded; AC2.5 now cites atomic conditional updates with outcome unchanged.

findings.description: Decision says a NOT_ALLOWED CHECK enforces normal-side balance, and the ADR states bigint overflow needs no handling; both are fine, but the CHECK needs the type/policy columns on accounts, which T-012 must confirm exist.
